text:
Use with caution / monitor

Fluoxetine acts as an inhibitor of the CYP2D6 enzyme, which can result in the inhibition of tramadol metabolism [tramadol:clinical_pharmacology:20]. Additionally, as a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI), concurrent use with tramadol affects the serotonergic neurotransmitter system and increases the risk of serious adverse events like serotonin syndrome and seizures [tramadol:drug_interactions:2, tramadol:drug_interactions:9]. Patients receiving this combination should be evaluated frequently for adverse reactions [tramadol:drug_interactions:2].
